name: Rinnah
overview: Rinnah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Shimon. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, with no additional narrative details or roles recorded in Scripture. His lineage places him within the broader context of the tribe of Judah during the time of the chronicler.
namesAndTitles: The name Rinnah means 'ringing cry [of joy] to YHWH,' reflecting a joyful expression directed toward the Lord. This proper name, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:20, does not indicate that it was given directly by God but does reveal a devotional aspect embedded in his name.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Rinnah was the son of Shimon, establishing a clear paternal relationship. No other family connections or relationships are documented beyond this direct filial link.
scriptureSignificance: Rinnah's significance lies in his inclusion within the genealogical records of Judah, affirming the continuity of God's covenant people through successive generations. Although his role is not expanded upon, his mention underscores the importance of preserving the lineage and heritage of the tribe of Judah. This genealogical note contributes to the biblical emphasis on God's faithfulness in sustaining His chosen people.
